question.en: How many orders are there?
question.es: ¿Cuántos pedidos hay?
question.ca: Quantes comandes hi ha?

reference.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

question.en: How many customers are there?
question.es: ¿Cuántos clientes hay?
question.ca: Quants clients hi ha?

reference.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers FROM orders;

question.en: Which region has the highest sales?
question.es: ¿Qué región tiene las mayores ventas?
question.ca: Quina regió té les vendes més altes?

reference.sql: SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

question.en: Which category generated the highest profit?
question.es: ¿Qué categoría generó el mayor beneficio?
question.ca: Quina categoria va generar el benefici més alt?

reference.sql: SELECT category, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1;

question.en: What are the total sales by region?
question.es: ¿Cuáles son las ventas totales por región?
question.ca: Quines són les vendes totals per regió?

reference.sql: SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY region;

reference.sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM orders GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 5;
